away.summary: The Blue Jackets (5-6-0) are projected to dress 11 forwards and seven defensemen with Ivan Provorov expected to make his season debut after missing the first 11 games with a lower-body injury. Isac Lundestrom remains out with a lower-body injury, while Emil Andrae, Dmitri Voronkov, and Luca Del Bel Belluz are listed as scratched. Jet Greaves is the first goalie listed in the projected lineup.

home.summary: The Stars (7-5-1) are coming off a 5-2 loss to Montreal and sit 3-2-0 on a six-game homestand. Esa Lindell will return after missing five games with a lower-body injury, and David Perron will make his Stars debut after signing a one-year contract Oct. 16. Kyle Capobianco, Radek Faksa, Oskar Bäck, and Matt Duchene remain out with injuries, while Trey Taylor is scratched. Jake Oettinger is the first goalie listed in the projected lineup.
